name: hud_signal_on_a
description: Signal sits on the card's A (design 5.7): A, then a click on the ground, a creep or a tower, sends one signal there (the slot lights while it waits for the click, and a placement stops), and a signal on a tower leaves the selection alone. Three in five seconds is the most: the fourth is refused with a notice. A signal costs no gold and leaves no order waiting.

steps.msg: A waits for the click that says where, its slot lit; the placement stops

steps.assert: not node('BuildController').signaling and not node('Hud').card()[3].active and scene.settled() and Game.gold == gold
steps.msg: the click signals there: one signal, no gold, nothing left waiting
a signal on a tower does not select it
the fourth in five seconds is refused, and says so
